data.long_meaning: The name Mursila is derived from the Arabic word 'mursilah', which means grape vine. It is a beautiful and evocative name that symbolizes growth, renewal, and the sweetness of life. The name Mursila carries the meaning “Grapevine” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Mursila usually hope their child will grow to embody grapevine and live with faith, good character and purpose.
